title: 13 Best Herbal Creams For Ankylosing Spondylitis
intro: Herbal creams for ankylosing spondylitis are topical preparations that combine natural ingredients with therapeutic properties to alleviate symptoms of this chronic inflammatory disease. They work by reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and improving joint mobility, providing relief from the condition's debilitating effects. Examples of herbal creams used to treat ankylosing spondylitis include capsaicin cream, which contains the active compound found in chili peppers that reduces pain and inflammation; arnica cream, which has anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties to soothe joint pain and swelling; and willow bark cream, which contains salicin, a natural analgesic similar to aspirin, to reduce pain and inflammation. Other herbal creams such as CBD cream, turmeric cream, and ginger cream also show promise in treating ankylosing spondylitis due to their anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
